name: The Hunter's Way
summary: In Mulgore, young adventurers follow The Hunter's Way under Skorn Whitecloud's guidance. You hunt flatland prowlers and take their claws to Melor Stonehoof on Thunder Bluff's Hunter Rise, proving your skill and respect for the wild.

sections.title: A Tradition of the Plains
sections.body: Among the tauren, hunting is one of the highest honors. It asks for patience, care for the Earth Mother's balance, and respect for the beasts of the plains. Elder Skorn Whitecloud tracked across Kalimdor for decades before coming to rest in Mulgore. Seeing young adventurers eager to roam, he gives them a traditional trial to turn ambition into discipline.

sections.title: The Stalkers of the Grasslands
sections.body: Flatland prowlers test a candidate's tracking skill. Great cats, they move swiftly and quietly through Mulgore's high grass, then ambush their prey. Bring four sets of claws to show you can find a predator before it finds you. Then turn its own ferocity against it.

sections.title: Reaching Hunter Rise
sections.body: With the claws gathered, you climb the wooden towers and bridges to Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff. Melor Stonehoof receives the trophies there. A master tracker, Melor values Skorn Whitecloud's ancient wisdom. He accepts the claws as proof that you have the spirit to learn more of Kalimdor's hunting ways.

faq.q: Who offers the task to walk the Hunter's Way?
faq.answer: Skorn Whitecloud, an elder resting in Mulgore, offers the trial to young adventurers eager to master the wilderness.

faq.q: Where do I take the flatland prowler claws?
faq.answer: Take the flatland prowler claws to Melor Stonehoof on the Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: Why are flatland prowler claws chosen as the tribute?
faq.answer: Flatland prowlers are stealthy and dangerous hunters of Mulgore's grasslands. Tracking and defeating them tests the sharp eyes, patience, and discipline needed for advanced hunting.

faq.q: Is this quest restricted only to the Hunter class?
faq.answer: No. Skorn Whitecloud offers this test to any young Horde adventurer eager to roam and learn the traditions of the plains.

faq.q: Where does the hunter's journey lead after speaking to Melor?
faq.answer: Melor Stonehoof recognizes your growing talent and directs you toward the harsher Barrens. There, experienced trackers such as Sergra Darkthorn can guide you.

faq.q: What significance does hunting hold in tauren culture?
aliases: why is hunting important to tauren
faq.answer: For the tauren, hunting is among the highest honors. It means living in harmony with the Earth Mother's creation, taking only what is needed, and respecting the quarry that sustains the tribes.

angles.text: As a young tauren, bringing prowler claws to Hunter Rise marks a rite of passage. Generations of ancestors hunted these same plains.
As a Hunter, you learn the wild's core lessons: stalk an ambush predator before it strikes, and read the grasslands' subtle signs.
As a Horde wanderer, you can learn tauren reverence for nature and earn their trust on Thunder Bluff's heights.
